chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Barqi, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Ja'far, from his father, from 'Ali عليه السلام.
That he gave judgment concerning a man who came with fire and ignited it in the house of some people, so it burned and their belongings burned.
He said: "He must pay the value of the house and what was in it, then he is to be killed."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on someone who intentionally burns another person's house and property in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling from Imam 'Ali عليه السلام regarding a man who deliberately set fire to the house of a people, causing the house and its contents to burn. The ruling combines financial liability for the destroyed property with capital punishment, indicating the gravity of deliberate destructive aggression against others.
